steps.expr: (() => { const svg=document.querySelector('svg'); if(!svg) return JSON.stringify({ok:false,why:'no svg',title:document.title}); const tn=[...svg.querySelectorAll('text')].find(t=>t.textContent.includes('THUNDER')); const tv=[...svg.querySelectorAll('text')].find(t=>t.textContent.trim()==='135'); const arc=document.getElementById('nameArc'); const rg=[...svg.querySelectorAll('g')].map(x=>x.getAttribute('transform')||'').filter(t=>t.includes('rotate')&&!t.includes(' 320 ')); const bn=tn?tn.getBBox():null; const bv=tv?tv.getBBox():null; return JSON.stringify({ok:!!tn, tot: arc?+arc.getTotalLength().toFixed(1):null, nameCtl: tn?+tn.getComputedTextLength().toFixed(1):null, ptCtl: tv?+tv.getComputedTextLength().toFixed(1):null, nameBbox: bn?{x:+bn.x.toFixed(1),y:+bn.y.toFixed(1),w:+bn.width.toFixed(1)}:null, ptBbox: bv?{x:+bv.x.toFixed(1),y:+bv.y.toFixed(1),w:+bv.width.toFixed(1)}:null, rankGroups: rg.slice(0,3), nameTxt: tn?tn.textContent:null}); })()
